records.anti_pattern: Do not imitate a reference composition or bundle this with generic glass cards, bento grids, or decorative 3D. The signature must remain: Pixel grids, indexed color, bitmap type, and low-frame motion are authored consistently with crisp modern access paths.
records.reference_role: Technique and current implementation research; not a composition template.
